scope: Independent adversarial re-audit of the strengthened row-D proof, especially the triangle-free 12-vertex edge minimum and equality uniqueness, its combination with the audited e(U)<=10 bound, and the exact remaining Ramsey-catalogue conditionality; no full order-41, Erdos 151, UNSAT, publication, novelty, or priority claim

binding_policy.rule: This JSON binds the completed re-audit Markdown and audited inputs but intentionally omits its own hash.

analytic_lemma_audit.claim: A triangle-free 12-vertex graph with alpha at most five has at most three components
analytic_lemma_audit.reason: R(3,3)=6 caps an alpha-two component at five vertices; alpha-one components have at most two. Four components cover at most 5+2+2+2=11 vertices, five cover at most ten, and six already give alpha at least six.

analytic_lemma_audit.claim: Such a graph cannot have at most ten edges
analytic_lemma_audit.reason: For k=1 connectedness needs at least 11 edges; k=2 forces a forest; k=3 has total cycle rank at most one. Tree ceil(s/2) and unicyclic floor(s/2) independence bounds, with parity at total order 12, force alpha at least six.

analytic_lemma_audit.claim: The bicyclic equality branch contains no counterexample
analytic_lemma_audit.reason: Theta and figure-eight cores, and dumbbells with at most one odd core cycle, have a vertex meeting all odd cycles, so deletion leaves a bipartite graph and the component contributes at least floor(s/2). The only remaining two-odd-cycle dumbbell forces two C5s joined by an edge plus two isolated components and still has an independent six-set. The independent spanning-tree-extension enumeration confirms this branch exhaustively.

analytic_lemma_audit.claim: Equality at 11 edges is unique up to isomorphism
analytic_lemma_audit.reason: The only surviving cycle-rank distribution is two non-bipartite odd-order unicyclic components plus one even tree. Triangle-freeness and total order force sizes 5,5,2, hence C5 disjoint-union C5 disjoint-union K2.

independent_exact_enumerator.method: One representative of every unlabelled tree from NetworkX 3.5, followed by all one- and two-nonedge additions; separate bitset triangle and exact-alpha routines; no import or call of the supplied profile checker
independent_exact_enumerator.coverage_argument: Deleting the one or two non-tree edges of any connected unicyclic or bicyclic graph yields a spanning tree, so the construction covers every relevant connected isomorphism type, with harmless duplicates.
